steps: Step 1: Enter a valid search keyword into the search field
Step 3: Verify that a list of products matching the keyword is displayed
expected_result: The search results page shows products whose titles or descriptions contain the entered keyword
Each product entry displays an image, name, price and add-to-cart option

steps: Step 1: Leave the search field empty
Step 3: Verify that all products in the store are displayed
expected_result: The product listing page shows the complete inventory of the store without any filtering
No search result message is shown

scenario: Search with a keyword that yields no results
steps: Step 1: Enter an unlikely search keyword into the search field
Step 3: Verify that a message indicating no products were found is displayed
expected_result: "No matching products were found for your selection." message appears prominently on the page
The product list area remains empty or shows a placeholder image
